mapper.select: WITH MY_KEY_IDS AS ( SELECT HAK.KEY_NAME, HAKA.AUTH_CD, HAKA.PRJ_ID, HAKA.AUTH_ID, HAK.KEY_ID, HAKA.REG_USER_ID FROM HCP_API_KEY HAK JOIN HCP_API_KEY_AUTH HAKA ON HAK.KEY_ID = HAKA.KEY_ID JOIN TABLE(HCP_GET_AUTH_PRJ(#{sysEmpNo})) PRJ ON HAKA.PRJ_ID = PRJ.PRJ_ID WHERE HAKA.AUTH_CD = 'PSN' AND HAKA.REG_USER_ID = #{sysEmpNo} ) SELECT HAS.SVC_ID, MKI.KEY_ID, MKI.KEY_NAME, MKI.PRJ_ID, MKI.REG_USER_ID AS SYS_EMP_NO FROM ( SELECT * FROM HCP_API_SVC WHERE SVC_ENV = UPPER('${hcp.application.env}') ) HAS JOIN ( SELECT INS.*, SUB.APRV_REASON, SUB.REG_USER_ID, SUB.UPD_DTTM FROM ( SELECT B.SVC_ID, SUB.KEY_ID, SUB.SUB_STAT_CD, MAX(SUB.SUB_ID) AS SUB_ID FROM HCP_API_BASE B JOIN HCP_API_PUB P ON B.API_ID = P.API_ID JOIN HCP_API_SUB SUB ON SUB.PUB_ID = P.PUB_ID WHERE SUB.SUB_STAT_CD IN ('NOR', 'APR') GROUP BY B.SVC_ID, SUB.KEY_ID, SUB.SUB_STAT_CD ) INS JOIN HCP_API_SUB SUB ON SUB.SUB_ID = INS.SUB_ID ) Z ON HAS.SVC_ID = Z.SVC_ID JOIN MY_KEY_IDS MKI ON MKI.KEY_ID = Z.KEY_ID WHERE HAS.SHOW_YN = 'Y' AND (HAS.DEL_YN = 'N' OR (HAS.DEL_YN = 'Y' AND HAS.RES_DTTM >= SYSDATE))
